name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar with control toward the mid chest.
Press the bar upward until the arms are extended without locking aggressively.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower the dumbbells beside the chest.
Press up smoothly while keeping the shoulder blades stable.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand upright holding the bar at shoulder width.
Curl the bar while keeping elbows close to the torso.
Lower under control.

name: Alternate Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and palms facing the torso.
Curl one dumbbell while keeping the upper arm stationary.
Lower and alternate sides.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand at a high pulley and hold the attachment.
Keep elbows tucked and extend the forearms downward.
Return slowly without moving the upper arms.

name: Pullups
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull the torso upward by driving the elbows down.
Lower under control to a full hang.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips while keeping the spine neutral.
Row the bar toward the lower torso.
Lower the bar under control.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot.
Brace the torso and push the floor away while keeping the bar close.
Finish tall, then return the bar with a controlled hip hinge.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Place the bar securely across the upper back.
Sit down and back while keeping the torso braced.
Drive through the feet to stand.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower the platform until the knees are comfortably bent.
Press through the full foot to extend the legs.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar in front of the thighs.
Hinge at the hips while keeping a slight bend in the knees.
Return by extending the hips.

name: Standing Calf Raises
instructions: Stand with the balls of the feet supported.
Rise onto the toes as high as comfortable.
Lower the heels under control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit upright with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead until the arms are extended.
Lower smoothly to shoulder level.

name: Side Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells by your sides.
Raise the arms laterally to around shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold a bar in front of the thighs.
Elevate the shoulders straight upward.
Pause briefly and lower.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Rest the forearms on a bench with wrists free.
Curl the weight by flexing the wrists.
Return with control.

name: Crunches
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent.
Flex the trunk to lift the shoulder blades.
Lower with control while maintaining tension.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Set the upper back against a stable bench.
Drive the hips upward while keeping the ribs controlled.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and lower.

name: Adductor
instructions: Lie face down with one inner thigh on a foam roll.
Move slowly between hip and knee while relaxing into the pressure.

name: Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads outside the knees.
Open the legs against resistance.
Return slowly.

name: Neck Resistance
instructions: Apply gentle manual resistance against the head.
Hold a neutral neck position against the resistance.
Repeat in multiple directions without pain.
